arguments.message:
You can subscribe to incident notifications directly from our status page. Click the **Subscribe** button and choose the delivery method that works best for your team—email, SMS, or a webhook. 

- **Email or SMS**: You’ll receive a message as soon as an incident is opened, updated, or resolved.
- **Webhook**: This is the fastest option; it pushes real‑time updates into any on‑call or alerting tool you already use.

If your team only needs alerts for certain parts of the platform, you can scope the subscription to specific components so you won’t be paged for unrelated incidents. Once set up, the notifications will surface incidents as they happen, keeping your team ahead of any issues.
